authority: Observed argv, input paths and post-run output paths come from actual normalized operation records.
Input bytes are selected only from workdir snapshots, digest-bound pre-run snapshots or readable bound task fixtures.
Reference-output cases preserve fidelity authority; source/task checks remain separate and can promote a case only through the existing lifecycle.
Existing optimizer validation suggestions are returned unchanged and are not regenerated.
claimBoundary: Deterministic completion wires resources and commands; it does not infer semantic expected answers. Missing or ambiguous facts remain unresolved and available for a bounded repair decision. The integration test uses a synthetic local program and does not count as a real model run, real-skill success, readiness change or prospective/held-out evidence.
